label: 6b — Formal Verification (FDR4)
summary: FDR4 loaded the CSP and was exploring the state space when it was killed by a signal (on macOS, the system's memory-pressure killer ends the largest process when memory runs out). Not a parse error.

issues.title: FDR4 killed — verdict unmeasured
issues.raw: FDR4 was killed by signal 9 before giving a verdict (peak memory seen by the monitor: 72031 MB).
issues.fix_directive: The model's state space exceeded the machine's memory, so FDR4 gave no verdict. The memory budget is already at the machine's limit and cannot be raised. This is not a parse error or a template defect. You may reduce the controller's state space in the Java (fewer transitions, fewer or narrower state variables, merged conditions), but only without changing the behaviour the requirements specify; otherwise record the FDR4 assertions as unmeasured.

next_step: Read each issue above, follow the fix directive, edit the linked Java file, and re-run Phase 6a (FDR4 Verification).
